title: CricAPI Series
description: A cricket series object as returned by the CricAPI series and series_info endpoints

id.description: Unique GUID identifier for this series

name.description: Name and year of the series

startDate.description: Start date of the series (Month Day format)

endDate.description: End date of the series (Month Day format)

odi.description: Number of ODI matches in this series

t20.description: Number of T20 matches in this series

test.description: Number of Test matches in this series

squads.description: Number of squads loaded (may be fewer than total if data is pending)

matches.description: Number of matches loaded (may be fewer than total if data is pending)
